name: Post Process Plotter
author: Acxel Orozco
description: Post-processing workbench for VASP, Quantum ESPRESSO and CP2K: band structures, DOS, PDOS, potentials and work functions, plus volumetric VASP fields (CHGCAR/LOCPOT/PARCHG/ELFCAR) with planar averages, vacuum levels, charge sums/differences and Gaussian cube export. Pure Python, with a terminal CLI and no Perl or external executables.
